commands.name: generate

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the file instead of writing it.

options.name: --entry-point
options.description: Also emit an entry point: none,  static:<Name>, or any. Defaults to none.

options.name: --entry-point-namespace
options.description: Namespace of the entry-point file. Defaults to the  emitted type's.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing file. Your edits to it are  lost.

options.name: --format
options.description: How the run reports itself: human or json. Defaults to human.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace of the emitted type. Defaults to the target  type's own.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where the file is written. Defaults to the current  directory.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project whose compilation is analyzed. Defaults to the only .csproj here.

arguments.name: TYPE
arguments.description: The type to scaffold a generator for. Repeat it to  scaffold several.

commands.description: Write the dummy generator for a type, as code you then  own.
